name: Segovia (Spain)
description: Sky blue field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Segovia (the aqueduct on white beneath a head).
history: The identifying symbols of Segovia are its arms, its flag and its anthem. The Regulation of Protocol, Honours and Distinctions of the city council, approved by the plenary on 26 December 1963 and by the Ministry of the Interior on 30 November 1965, was maintained until the 1980s, when the flag of the city of Segovia appeared, of sky blue satin with the arms at the centre, in contradiction with the 1965 regulation; the new Regulation of Protocol was published in the Boletín Oficial de la Provincia on 15 April 2011.
